lines.en: The wind parts the mane at my neck.
My paws press the dry grass.
Step by step, my shoulders roll.
I steer around a herd of wildebeest.
In the pride, I guard the young.
I walk with weight.
I push through waist-high grass.
I stop under an acacia.
I look toward the cubs.
I lower myself as I walk.
I step over a stone.
I leave prints in the grass.
My tail sweeps the seed heads aside.
I lie down, tail swaying.
I watch the edge of the plains.
A knot has formed in my mane.

lines.zh: 我趴在幼崽前面，一动不动。
lines.en: I lie before the cubs and do not move.
I listen for wildebeest beyond the grass.
I tuck my paws under me.
I yawn.
I lie on the rock waiting for sunset.
I lick the dust off my forepaw.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把头转到另一边。
lines.en: I turn my head the other way.

lines.zh: 我在树荫里换了个姿势。
lines.en: I change position in the shade.

lines.zh: 我数着草被风吹动的次数。
lines.en: I count the grass swaying in the wind.
My whiskers twitch.
I stretch out flat.
I wait for a herd to pass.
I raise my head from the tall grass.
I've smelled you twice before.
Stop where you are.
My tail has stopped.
I push up on my forelegs.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西我不感兴趣。
lines.en: What you hold doesn't interest me.

lines.zh: 我在你和我之间画了一条线。
lines.en: I have drawn a line between us.

lines.zh: 你的影子跑到我这边了。
lines.en: Your shadow has come over to my side.
I growl and my mane bristles.
You don't smell of spears.

lines.zh: 我给你一次退到幼崽外的机会。
lines.en: One chance to back off from the cubs.
You stepped on the cubs' prints.
I don't need you to stay.
My hind legs sink and I give ground.
A tuft of my mane came out.
A growl rolls in my throat.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了你的手腕。
lines.en: I remember that blow to your wrist.
I plant all four paws.
I turn to guard my shoulder.

lines.zh: 草原上我跑得比谁都快。
lines.en: No one outruns me on these plains.
I lower my shoulders.
My amber eyes stay on you.
I shake my head and my mane swings.
Throw it on the ground.
I move through the grass, low.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我等你退到草丛外。
lines.en: I won't snatch. Wait till you step out.
Are you carrying anything else?
I lower my head and sniff.
Steady. I'm watching closely.
That isn't enough for a pride.
Three steps back, then set it down.
The pride guards its cubs. Stay back.

lines.zh: 我肩上的鬃毛被撞乱了。
lines.en: My mane got mussed.
You've backed under the acacia.
In the pride, the cubs are behind me.
I shift my stance.
We bumped and I growled.

lines.zh: 你的靴底压住我的爪子。
lines.en: Your boot presses my paw.
I angle aside to clear the path.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀碰到我的鬃毛。
lines.en: Your shoulder touches my mane.
I ease back into the tall grass.
There are many lionesses in the pride.
My pride doesn't allow outsiders.
No two-legged ones in this pride.

lines.zh: 我把鬃毛转向幼崽那边。
lines.en: I turn my mane toward the cubs.
I am guarding the cubs.
Further from the cubs.
I lie back down.
There's more than me on these plains.
This grassland belongs to my pride.
I close my eyes; my nose keeps working.
I take it and back off.

lines.zh: 我一甩头，把它扔进草里。
lines.en: One head toss and it's in the grass.
I nose it over.
Not enough for the pride.
I grind it into the dirt with a hind paw.

lines.zh: 草里掉的我都要看一眼。
lines.en: Anything dropped in the grass gets a look.
Not mine; I drop it back.

lines.zh: 我用爪子把它拨到一边。
lines.en: I flick it aside with a paw.
I press it under the root.
You stepped over the line in the grass.
I rise out of the grass.
My mane is all up.
You've backed toward the cubs.
I count, then spring.
I flatten my belly to the grass.
Where you stand is theirs.

lines.zh: 我一步一步把距离吃掉。
lines.en: I eat up the distance step by step.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴绷直，压进草里。
lines.en: I stiffen my tail and press into the grass.
You go left; I cut further left.
My claws rake the ground.
Do you hear the growl?
You've backed under the acacia.
That is mine.
Half a body length closer.
Your hand is going to your waist.
I crouch low, tail still.
I pounce low through the grass.
My claws land first.
That bite took your arm.
I leap in and hit you with my shoulder.
You land on your back in the grass.
My claws pin your chest.
That pounce was quicker than the wind.
You block; your arm shakes.
I step back, tail still low.
I draw my claws back into the grass.
I rise out of the tall grass.
My mane is still new.

lines.zh: 我甩头，鬃毛上的草屑飞了。
lines.en: I shake the grass bits from my mane.
I hear wildebeest far off.
I walk to the shade.

lines.zh: 我先看看太阳升到哪了。
lines.en: First I check how high the sun has got.
I begin patrolling the plains.

lines.zh: 狮群就在后面，我收起爪子。
lines.en: The pride is behind me. I sheathe my claws.
I look for a scent mark.
I sit down in the grass.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的鬃毛，我跳开。
lines.en: Fire singes my mane and I spring away.
Water pulls me down; I kick.
The noise makes me flatten.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我肩上的鬃毛里。
lines.en: An arrow buries in my shoulder mane.

lines.zh: 紫光一晃，我的瞳孔缩了。
lines.en: Violet light and my pupils shrink.
I have been hungry for days.

lines.zh: 雷光里我的鬃毛全竖了。
lines.en: In the flash my mane stood straight up.

lines.zh: 狮群里护幼，落下来却没人。
lines.en: The pride guards its cubs. Here I fall alone.
